scanNote: 15-mashqning matnida 19 va 20-bo'shliqlar ('I came home early and I wanted to eat something') Meri qo'shtirnog'idan keyin, lekin 'Steve said' dan OLDIN bosilgan. Mantiqan bu so'zlarni STIV aytadi (uyga erta kelgan va ovqat yegani oshxonaga tushgan odam — Stiv). Kitobning tinish belgilari joylashuvi shu o'rinda chalkash, lekin fe'l shakllariga bu ta'sir qilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story and put the verbs in brackets into the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani o'qing va qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ HIKOYA (to'ldirilgan holda):

  NOISES IN THE NIGHT

  On a warm summer night last July, Mary Bond 1) WAS alone
  in her bedroom. Her husband, Steve, was a doctor and he
  often 2) WORKED at night. That night, Mary was tired, so
  she 3) DECIDED to go to bed. Suddenly, she 4) HEARD a
  loud crash downstairs.

  She 5) WALKED nervously to the door and 6) LISTENED
  carefully. She could hear strange noises downstairs,
  probably from the kitchen. She 7) FELT very frightened,
  so she 8) PICKED UP the phone in her room and 9) CALLED
  the police. After that, she 10) HID under the bed.

  Five minutes later, she heard the police car outside.
  Anxiously, she 11) WENT downstairs to meet them. She
  12) WALKED into the kitchen and 13) SAW a man on the
  floor. One of the policemen 14) HAD a gun to the man's
  head. When Mary 15) LOOKED at the man, she was shocked.
  "Oh, gosh! I'm so sorry, Steve!" she 16) WHISPERED
  quietly.

  The two policemen 17) LOOKED strangely at Mary. "It's my
  husband," she 18) SAID. "I 19) CAME home early and I
  20) WANTED to eat something." Steve said, "I 21) THOUGHT
  you were asleep and I 22) DIDN'T WANT to wake you."


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  TUNDAGI ShOVQINLAR

  O'tgan iyuldagi issiq yoz kechasida Meri Bond yotoqxonasida
  yolg'iz edi. Uning eri Stiv shifokor edi va u ko'pincha
  tunda ishlardi. O'sha kechasi Meri charchagan edi,
  shuning uchun yotishga qaror qildi. To'satdan pastdan
  baland taraqlashni eshitdi.

  U asabiy holda eshik tomon yurdi va diqqat bilan
  quloq soldi. Pastdan, ehtimol oshxonadan, g'alati
  shovqinlarni eshitdi. Juda qo'rqib ketdi, shuning uchun
  xonasidagi telefonni oldi va militsiyaga qo'ng'iroq
  qildi. Shundan keyin karavot ostiga yashirindi.

  Besh daqiqadan keyin tashqarida militsiya mashinasini
  eshitdi. Xavotir bilan ularni kutib olish uchun pastga
  tushdi. Oshxonaga kirdi va polda bir erkakni ko'rdi.
  Militsionerlardan biri erkakning boshiga qurol tirab
  turgan edi. Meri erkakka qaraganda, dovdirab qoldi.
  "Voy xudo! Kechir, Stiv!" — dedi u sekin pichirlab.

  Ikki militsioner Meriga g'alati qaradi. "Bu mening
  erim," — dedi u. "Men uyga erta keldim va bir narsa
  yegim keldi." Stiv dedi: "Men sen uxlayapsan deb
  o'ylagandim va seni uyg'otgim kelmadi."


HIKOYANING KULGILI BURILIShI:
  Meri o'g'ri deb o'ylagan odam — o'zining ERI ekan.
  Militsiya uning erini polga yotqizib, qurol tirab
  turgan edi! Bu — 12-mashqdagi 'The Thief' hikoyasining
  oxiri bilan bir xil g'oya (onasi chiqib qolgani).

DIQQAT — NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR ShU MASHQDA:
  be → WAS        hear → HEARD    feel → FELT
  hide → HID      go → WENT       see → SAW
  have → HAD      say → SAID      come → CAME
  think → THOUGHT

DIQQAT — TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (-ed):
  work → worked      decide → decided   walk → walked
  listen → listened  pick up → picked up  call → called
  look → looked      whisper → whispered  want → wanted

items.textEn: Mary Bond 1) ............ (be) alone in her bedroom.
items.whyUz:
be → WAS (birlik uchun).
'alone' = yolg'iz.

items.textEn: Her husband, Steve, was a doctor and he often 2) ............ (work) at night.
items.whyUz:
work → WORKED (-ed).
'often' bo'lsa ham — bu O'TMIShdagi ODAT,
shuning uchun past simple.

items.textEn: That night, Mary was tired, so she 3) ............ (decide) to go to bed.
items.whyUz:
decide → DECIDED (faqat -d qo'shiladi).
'decide TO + asosiy fe'l' — qolip.

items.textEn: Suddenly, she 4) ............ (hear) a loud crash downstairs.
items.whyUz:
hear → HEARD (noto'g'ri).
'a loud crash' = baland taraqlash.
'downstairs' = pastda, pastki qavatda.

items.textEn: She 5) ............ (walk) nervously to the door ...
items.whyUz:
walk → WALKED.
'nervously' — RAVISh (nervous + ly).

items.textEn: ... and 6) ............ (listen) carefully.
items.whyUz:
listen → LISTENED ('t' O'QILMAYDI).
'carefully' — RAVISh.

items.textEn: She 7) ............ (feel) very frightened ...
items.whyUz:
feel → FELT (noto'g'ri).
'frightened' = qo'rqib ketgan.
'feel + SIFAT' — qolip.

items.textEn: ... so she 8) ............ (pick up) the phone in her room ...
items.whyUz:
pick up → PICKED UP.
Faqat BIRINChI so'z o'zgaradi, 'up' o'zgarmaydi.
'pick up the phone' = telefonni ko'tarmoq.

items.textEn: ... and 9) ............ (call) the police.
items.whyUz:
call → CALLED.
'call the police' = militsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.

items.textEn: After that, she 10) ............ (hide) under the bed.
items.whyUz:
hide → HID (noto'g'ri).
'hide UNDER the bed' — 46-betdagi 12-mashqda
ham aynan shu ibora bor edi.

items.textEn: Anxiously, she 11) ............ (go) downstairs to meet them.
items.whyUz:
go → WENT (noto'g'ri).
'anxiously' = xavotir bilan.
'go downstairs' — predlog YO'Q.

items.textEn: She 12) ............ (walk) into the kitchen ...
items.whyUz:
walk → WALKED.
'walk INTO' = ichkariga kirmoq (45-betdagi
harakat predloglaridan).

items.textEn: ... and 13) ............ (see) a man on the floor.
items.whyUz:
see → SAW (noto'g'ri).
DIQQAT: 'a MAN' — 'a policeman' EMAS.
Bu 15b-mashqning 8-bandi uchun muhim.

items.textEn: One of the policemen 14) ............ (have) a gun to the man's head.
items.whyUz:
have → HAD (noto'g'ri).
'One of the policemen' — 'one of' dan keyin
KO'PLIK, lekin fe'l BIRLIK.
'a gun' = qurol.

items.textEn: When Mary 15) ............ (look) at the man, she was shocked.
items.whyUz:
look → LOOKED.
'look AT' — predlog AT.
'shocked' = dovdirab qolgan.

items.textEn: "Oh, gosh! I'm so sorry, Steve!" she 16) ............ (whisper) quietly.
items.whyUz:
whisper → WHISPERED.
'to whisper' = pichirlamoq.
'quietly' — RAVISh (sekin).
DIQQAT: bu 15b-mashqning 9-bandi uchun muhim.

items.textEn: The two policemen 17) ............ (look) strangely at Mary.
items.whyUz:
look → LOOKED.
'strangely' — RAVISh (strange + ly).

items.textEn: "It's my husband," she 18) ............ (say).
items.whyUz:
say → SAID (noto'g'ri; 'sed' deb o'qiladi).
DIQQAT: 'my HUSBAND' — bu 15b-mashqning
10-bandi uchun muhim.

items.textEn: "I 19) ............ (come) home early ...
items.whyUz:
come → CAME (noto'g'ri).
'come home' — predlog YO'Q.
Mantiqan bu so'zlarni STIV aytadi (yuqoridagi
izohga qarang).

items.textEn: ... and I 20) ............ (want) to eat something."
items.whyUz:
want → WANTED.
'want TO + asosiy fe'l' — qolip.

items.textEn: Steve said, "I 21) ............ (think) you were asleep ...
items.whyUz:
think → THOUGHT (noto'g'ri).
'asleep' = uxlab yotgan (SIFAT, 'be' bilan).

items.textEn: ... and I 22) ............ (not/want) to wake you."
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE INKOR: DIDN'T + WANT (asosiy shakl).
'didn't wanted' XATO.
'to wake sb' = kimnidir uyg'otmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  Mary was ~~with her husband~~ in her bedroom.
                                        alone

  Xato qism chizib tashlanadi va TO'G'RI so'z
  ustiga yoziladi.

USUL:
  Har bir gapni 15a-mashqdagi matn bilan solishtiring
  va MOS KELMAYDIGAN so'zni toping.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  with her husband → ALONE          (namuna)
   2  unhappy         → TIRED
   3  voice           → CRASH
   4  calmly          → NERVOUSLY
   5  music           → NOISES
   6  angry           → FRIGHTENED
   7  Ten minutes     → FIVE MINUTES
   8  a policeman     → A MAN
   9  loudly          → QUIETLY
  10  brother         → HUSBAND

DIQQAT — 4 va 9-BANDLAR RAVISh:
  calmly (xotirjam) ↔ nervously (asabiy) — QARAMA-QARShI
  loudly (baland)   ↔ quietly (sekin)    — QARAMA-QARShI
  Bu Unit 11 ning asosiy mavzusi — RAVIShLAR.

DIQQAT — 8-BAND ALDAMChI:
  Matnda 'she saw A MAN on the floor' —
  polda yotgan odam militsioner EMAS, u Stiv edi.
  Militsionerlar TIK turgan edi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  calmly     = xotirjam
  unhappy    = baxtsiz, xafa
  a voice    = ovoz
  loudly     = baland ovozda

items.textEn: 1  Mary was WITH HER HUSBAND in her bedroom.
items.whyUz:
Matn: 'Mary Bond WAS ALONE in her bedroom.'
Eri Stiv o'sha kecha ishda deb o'ylangan edi.

items.textEn: 2  Mary was UNHAPPY, so she decided to go to bed.
items.whyUz:
Matn: 'Mary was TIRED, so she decided to go to bed.'
'unhappy' (xafa) EMAS — 'tired' (charchagan).

items.textEn: 3  She heard a loud VOICE downstairs.
4  She walked CALMLY to the door.
items.whyUz:
Matn: 'She walked NERVOUSLY to the door.'
'calmly' (xotirjam) — 'nervously' ning
QARAMA-QARShISI. Meri qo'rqqan edi.

items.textEn: 5  She could hear strange MUSIC downstairs.
items.whyUz:
Matn: 'She could hear strange NOISES downstairs.'
Hikoyaning nomi ham 'Noises in the Night'.
'noises' KO'PLIK shaklda.

items.textEn: 6  She felt very ANGRY, so she called the police.
items.whyUz:
Matn: 'She FELT very FRIGHTENED.'
'angry' (jahli chiqqan) EMAS —
'frightened' (qo'rqib ketgan).

items.textEn: 7  TEN MINUTES later, she heard the police car outside.
items.whyUz:
Matn: 'FIVE MINUTES later, she heard the police
car outside.'
Son xato — 'ten' emas, 'five'.

items.textEn: 8  She walked into the kitchen and saw A POLICEMAN on the floor.
items.whyUz:
Matn: 'she saw A MAN on the floor.'
Polda yotgan odam — Stiv (Merining eri),
militsioner EMAS.
Militsionerlar tik turgan va unga qurol
tirab turgan edi.

items.textEn: 9  "I'm so sorry, Steve!" she whispered LOUDLY.
items.whyUz:
Matn: 'she WHISPERED QUIETLY.'
'loudly' (baland ovozda) 'whisper' (pichirlamoq)
bilan MANTIQAN mos kelmaydi.

items.textEn: 10  "It's my BROTHER," she explained.
items.hintUz: Polda yotgan odam Meriga kim bo'ladi?
items.whyUz:
Matn: '"It's my HUSBAND," she said.'
Stiv — Merining ERI.
DIQQAT: kitob 'explained' fe'lini o'zgartirishni
so'ramaydi — asosiy xato 'brother' so'zida
(matnda 'said' deyilgan).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
THE EARTHQUAKE (ZILZILA) — 10 ta voqea.

TO'LIQ RO'YXAT (to'ldirilgan holda):

   1  Last summer, David WENT on holiday with his dog, Leo.
   2  They SPENT most of the time on the beach.
   3  One night, David WAS in bed.
   4  Leo STARTED barking.
   5  David ASKED him to be quiet.
   6  Suddenly, the earth STARTED shaking.
   7  David TOOK Leo under the door frame.
   8  Stones FELL on David's bed.
   9  David WAS lucky to be alive.
  10  David WAS proud of Leo.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  O'tgan yozda Devid iti Leo bilan ta'tilga bordi.
   2  Ular ko'p vaqtni plyajda o'tkazdilar.
   3  Bir kechasi Devid karavotda edi.
   4  Leo hura boshladi.
   5  Devid undan jim bo'lishni so'radi.
   6  To'satdan yer silkina boshladi.
   7  Devid Leoni eshik romi tagiga olib bordi.
   8  Devidning karavotiga toshlar tushdi.
   9  Devid tirik qolgani uchun omadli edi.
  10  Devid Leo bilan faxrlandi.


DIQQAT — NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  go → WENT      spend → SPENT     be → WAS
  take → TOOK    fall → FELL

DIQQAT — TO'G'RI FE'L:
  start → STARTED    ask → ASKED

DIQQAT — 'START' DAN KEYIN -ING:
  'started BARKING', 'started SHAKING'
  'start' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi.

DIQQAT — 4, 9, 10-BANDLAR 'BE' BILAN:
  'David WAS in bed' (joy)
  'David WAS lucky' (sifat)
  'David WAS proud of Leo' (sifat + of)

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an earthquake  = zilzila
  to bark        = hurmoq (it haqida)
  to shake       = silkinmoq
  a door frame   = eshik romi
  a stone        = tosh
  alive          = tirik
  proud of       = ... bilan faxrlanadigan
  to spend time  = vaqt o'tkazmoq

items.textEn: 1  Last summer, David ............ (go) on holiday with his dog, Leo.
items.whyUz:
go → WENT.
'go ON holiday' — predlog ON.
'Last summer' → past simple.

items.textEn: 2  They ............ (spend) most of the time on the beach.
items.whyUz:
spend → SPENT (noto'g'ri).
'spend time' = vaqt o'tkazmoq.
'ON the beach' — predlog ON.

items.textEn: 3  One night, David ............ (be) in bed.
items.whyUz:
be → WAS.
'in bed' — artikl YO'Q ('in the bed' EMAS).

items.textEn: 4  Leo ............ (start) barking.
items.whyUz:
start → STARTED.
DIQQAT: 'start' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi:
'started BARKING'.
'to bark' = hurmoq.

items.textEn: 5  David ............ (ask) him to be quiet.
items.whyUz:
ask → ASKED.
'ask sb TO + asosiy fe'l' — qolip.
Rasmda: 'Quiet Leo. Everyone's sleeping.'

items.textEn: 6  Suddenly, the earth ............ (start) shaking.
items.whyUz:
start → STARTED + SHAKING (-ing).
'the earth' = yer.
Bu — zilzilaning boshlanishi.

items.textEn: 7  David ............ (take) Leo under the door frame.
items.whyUz:
take → TOOK (noto'g'ri).
'a door frame' = eshik romi.
Zilzilada eshik romi tagi eng xavfsiz joy
hisoblanadi.

items.textEn: 8  Stones ............ (fall) on David's bed.
items.whyUz:
fall → FELL (noto'g'ri).
'Stones' KO'PLIK, lekin past simple da
fe'l o'zgarmaydi.
Agar Devid karavotda qolganda — halok bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 9  David ............ (be) lucky to be alive.
items.whyUz:
be → WAS.
'lucky to be alive' = tirik qolgani uchun omadli.
'alive' = tirik (SIFAT).

items.textEn: 10  David ............ (be) proud of Leo.
items.whyUz:
be → WAS.
'proud OF sb' = kimdir bilan faxrlanmoq.
Leo hurib Devidni uyg'otgani uchun
u tirik qoldi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, read the list of events in a) and put the pictures in the correct order, then tell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, a) dagi voqealar ro'yxatini o'qing va rasmlarni to'g'ri tartibda joylashtiring, so'ng hikoyani aytib bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI RASM — A, B, C, D, E, F.

RASMLARDA NIMA TASVIRLANGAN:

  A — Devid karavotda o'tiribdi va itga gapiryapti.
      Gap pufagi: 'Quiet Leo. Everyone's sleeping.'
      → 5-voqea (David asked him to be quiet)

  B — Devid chamadon ('TRAVEL') va iti bilan
      avtobus bekatida ('BUS STATION')
      → 1-voqea (went on holiday with his dog)

  C — Devid Leoni quchoqlab eshik romi tagida turibdi
      → 7-voqea (took Leo under the door frame)

  D — Devid plyajda, cho'milish kiyimida, it bilan
      yugurib yuribdi
      → 2-voqea (spent most of the time on the beach)

  E — Devid karavotda uxlayapti, it yonida turibdi
      → 3-4-voqea (David was in bed / Leo started barking)

  F — Devid toshlar tushgan buzilgan karavotga qarab
      turibdi
      → 8-voqea (Stones fell on David's bed)


TO'G'RI TARTIB:

     1-o'rin  →  B   (ta'tilga jo'nash)
     2-o'rin  →  D   (plyaj)
     3-o'rin  →  E   (kechasi karavotda, it huradi)
     4-o'rin  →  A   ('Quiet Leo')
     5-o'rin  →  C   (eshik romi tagida)
     6-o'rin  →  F   (toshlar tushgan karavot)

  Ya'ni:  B - D - E - A - C - F


RASM QUTIChALARIGA YOZILADIGAN RAQAMLAR:
     A = 4     B = 1     C = 5
     D = 2     E = 3     F = 6


QANDAY ANIQLANDI:
  Har bir rasm 16a-mashqdagi ANIQ bir gapga mos keladi —
  chamadon/bekat, plyaj, karavot+huruvchi it,
  gap pufagi, eshik romi, toshlar.
  Hech biri taxmin emas.

pairs.left: B — chamadon va it bilan avtobus bekatida
pairs.right: 1  Last summer, David went on holiday with his dog, Leo.
pairs.rightUz: O'tgan yozda Devid iti Leo bilan ta'tilga bordi.
pairs.whyUz:
Chamadon va bekat → SAFARNING BOShI.
Rasmda it ham bor — 'his dog, Leo'.

pairs.left: D — plyajda it bilan yugurib yuribdi
pairs.right: 2  They spent most of the time on the beach.
pairs.whyUz:
Dengiz va qum → PLYAJ.
'They' = Devid va Leo — rasmda ikkalasi ham bor.

pairs.left: E — karavotda uxlayapti, it yonida turibdi
pairs.right: 3-4  One night, David was in bed. Leo started barking.
pairs.rightUz: Bir kechasi Devid karavotda edi. Leo hura boshladi.
pairs.whyUz:
Devid UXLAYAPTI, it esa UYG'OQ →
3 va 4-voqealar birga.
Bu — A rasmidan OLDIN (u hali uyg'onmagan).

pairs.right: 5  David asked him to be quiet.
pairs.whyUz:
Gap pufagi ANIQ ko'rsatib turibdi:
'Quiet Leo' = Jim bo'l, Leo.
Devid UYG'ONGAN → E rasmidan KEYIN.

pairs.left: C — Leoni quchoqlab eshik romi tagida
pairs.right: 6-7  Suddenly, the earth started shaking. David took Leo under the door frame.
pairs.rightUz: To'satdan yer silkina boshladi. Devid Leoni eshik romi tagiga olib bordi.
pairs.whyUz:
Eshik romi va buzilgan devor → ZILZILA payti.
6-voqea (zilzila boshlandi) rasmsiz —
u 7-voqea bilan birga tasvirlangan.

pairs.left: F — toshlar tushgan karavotga qarab turibdi
pairs.right: 8-9-10  Stones fell on David's bed. David was lucky to be alive and proud of Leo.
pairs.rightUz: Devidning karavotiga toshlar tushdi. Devid tirik qolgani uchun omadli edi va Leo bilan faxrlandi.
pairs.whyUz:
Karavot vayron — agar Devid u yerda qolganda
halok bo'lardi.
Oxirgi rasm → hikoyaning TUGALLANMASI.

exercises.explanationUz:
16a dagi 10 ta gapni TO'LIQ HIKOYAGA aylantirish kerak.

Kitobning qoidasi (Coursebook 81-bet):
  hikoya 4 QISMDAN iborat —
  boshlanish, rivojlanish, asosiy voqea, tugallanma.

NIMA QO'ShISh KERAK:
  • bog'lovchilar: and, but, so, because, when, then
  • ravishlar: suddenly, luckily, quickly, immediately
  • vaqt iboralari: one night, a few seconds later,
    when the earthquake stopped
  • his-tuyg'ular: he was frightened, he was very tired


TO'LIQ NAMUNA HIKOYA (114 so'z):

  THE EARTHQUAKE

  Last summer, David went on holiday with his dog, Leo.
  They spent most of the time on the beach, swimming
  and playing in the sun.

  One night, David was in bed when Leo started barking
  loudly. David was very tired, so he asked him to be
  quiet. "Quiet, Leo. Everyone's sleeping," he said.

  Suddenly, the earth started shaking. It was an
  earthquake! David jumped out of bed quickly and took
  Leo under the door frame. A few seconds later, stones
  fell on David's bed.

  When the earthquake stopped, David looked at his
  bedroom. He was lucky to be alive because Leo woke
  him up. He was very proud of his brave dog.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  ZILZILA

  O'tgan yozda Devid iti Leo bilan ta'tilga bordi.
  Ular ko'p vaqtni plyajda o'tkazdilar — cho'mildilar
  va quyoshda o'ynadilar.

  Bir kechasi Devid karavotda edi, shunda Leo baland
  ovozda hura boshladi. Devid juda charchagan edi,
  shuning uchun undan jim bo'lishni so'radi.
  "Jim bo'l, Leo. Hamma uxlayapti," — dedi u.

  To'satdan yer silkina boshladi. Bu zilzila edi!
  Devid karavotdan tez sakrab tushdi va Leoni eshik
  romi tagiga olib bordi. Bir necha soniyadan keyin
  Devidning karavotiga toshlar tushdi.

  Zilzila to'xtaganda, Devid yotoqxonasiga qaradi.
  U tirik qolgani uchun omadli edi, chunki Leo uni
  uyg'otgan edi. U o'zining jasur iti bilan juda
  faxrlandi.


SO'Z SONI: 114 — kitob so'ragan 100-120 oralig'ida.

DIQQAT — QO'ShIMChA SO'ZLAR:
  brave = jasur
  to wake sb up = kimnidir uyg'otmoq
  to jump out of bed = karavotdan sakrab tushmoq

structure.heading: 1-qism — BOShLANISh (1-2-voqealar)
structure.guideUz:
'Last summer' bilan boshlang.
Plyajdagi vaqtni bir-ikki tafsilot bilan boyiting.
structure.modelEn: Last summer, David went on holiday with his dog, Leo. They spent most of the time on the beach, swimming and playing in the sun.

structure.heading: 2-qism — RIVOJLANISh (3-4-5-voqealar)
structure.guideUz:
'One night' bilan yangi xatboshi.
'when' bog'lovchisi bilan ikki voqeani birlashtiring.
To'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutq qo'shing (rasm A).
structure.modelEn: One night, David was in bed when Leo started barking loudly. David was very tired, so he asked him to be quiet. "Quiet, Leo. Everyone's sleeping," he said.

structure.heading: 3-qism — ASOSIY VOQEA (6-7-8-voqealar)
structure.guideUz:
'Suddenly' bilan boshlang — eng keskin payt.
'A few seconds later' vaqt iborasi bilan
toshlar tushishini bog'lang.
structure.modelEn: Suddenly, the earth started shaking. It was an earthquake! David jumped out of bed quickly and took Leo under the door frame. A few seconds later, stones fell on David's bed.

structure.heading: 4-qism — TUGALLANMA (9-10-voqealar)
structure.headingUz: Oxirida nima bo'ldi va qanday his qildi
structure.guideUz:
'When the earthquake stopped' bilan boshlang.
'because' bilan SABABNI ko'rsating.
HIS-TUYG'U bilan tugating — bu kitobning qoidasi.
structure.modelEn: When the earthquake stopped, David looked at his bedroom. He was lucky to be alive because Leo woke him up. He was very proud of his brave dog.

wordFormation.introUz: 47-bet — noto'g'ri fe'llar, ravishlar va qo'rquv lug'ati.

patterns.exampleEn: Suddenly, she heard a loud crash downstairs. Suddenly, the earth started shaking.
patterns.exampleUz: To'satdan u pastdan baland taraqlashni eshitdi. To'satdan yer silkina boshladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Suddenly' — hikoyada KUTILMAGAN voqeani kiritadi.
Gap boshida turadi va undan keyin VERGUL qo'yiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: She walked nervously to the door and listened carefully. She whispered quietly.
patterns.exampleUz: U asabiy holda eshik tomon yurdi va diqqat bilan quloq soldi. U sekin pichirladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
RAVISh harakat QANDAY bajarilganini aytadi.
Odatda fe'ldan keyin turadi.

patterns.exampleEn: She felt very frightened, so she picked up the phone and called the police.
patterns.exampleUz: U juda qo'rqib ketdi, shuning uchun telefonni oldi va militsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

patterns.formula: ega + was/were + lucky to be ... / proud of ... .
patterns.exampleEn: David was lucky to be alive. David was proud of Leo.
patterns.exampleUz: Devid tirik qolgani uchun omadli edi. Devid Leo bilan faxrlandi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Hikoyaning TUGALLANMASI — his-tuyg'u bilan.
'proud OF' — predlog OF.

patterns.formula: When + PAST SIMPLE, + ega + PAST SIMPLE.
patterns.exampleEn: When Mary looked at the man, she was shocked. When the earthquake stopped, David looked at his bedroom.
patterns.exampleUz: Meri erkakka qaraganda, dovdirab qoldi. Zilzila to'xtaganda, Devid yotoqxonasiga qaradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'When' ikki o'tgan voqeani bog'laydi.
Gap boshida bo'lsa — VERGUL qo'yiladi.
